book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: A JE' JU'UNA', CAJ U YɅN BAT'AN TS'IBTA PABLO TI' U YET ACSɅ'ORIROB ICH U CAJAR CORINTO 1 CORINTIOS

content: Rajen in wet acsa'orirex, an ten bic quin betic, p'isex a bʌjex a betej xan. Quire' a teno' quin betic an ten bic Cristo cu betic.
Cu tsicbar ti' xquic tu cu yocar u much'quinticob u bʌj quir yubicob u t'ʌn C'uj
Baje'rer, in wet acsa'orirex, jach qui' in wor, quire' tu cotor a ba' ca betiquex. Mʌ' ja wirej, rajra' ca c'ʌ'otiquenex, mʌ' ju tubur techex a ba' caj in camsaj techex uch.
Chen in c'at ca' a najtex wa Cristo raji' u jach ts'urir tu cotor xib, bayiri' xan, a xibo', raji' u jach ts'urir a xquico', bayiri' xan ic Tetex C'uj raji' u jach ts'urir a Jesucristojo'.
Rajen wa xib cu pixic u jo'r wa ber cu t'ʌnic C'uj, cax wa ʌcʌtan mac cax tu cu tsec'tic u t'ʌn C'uj a ts'a'b u tucur ten C'uj quir u tsicbar a ba' u c'at C'uj cu sura'quintic Cristo.

Bayiri' xan, wa xquic, cax chichan, cax carem, arej mʌ' ju pixic u jo'r tu cu t'ʌnic C'uj, cax tu cu ch'ictar u tsicbar u t'ʌn C'uj a ts'a'b u tucur ten C'uj ti'. Raji' cu sura'ctic a ray xquico' u ts'urir quire' a xico' raji' ir a xquico' rʌc c'os u jo'r irej wa jo'chta'b u jo'r.

Rajen, wa xquic mʌ' ju pixic u jo'r jeroj, jach manan tsoy ca' c'osac u jo'r. Chen wa ja ray xquico' cu pʌyic u su'tar quire' c'asa'an u jo'r soc jach yur u jo'r, jeroj rajen jach tsoy ca' u pix u jo'r.
A xibo' mʌ' ju yʌn p'ix u jo'r quire' ray yʌn beta'b ten C'uj soc bajen C'uj, soc quir u yesic raji' u yochir C'uj xan.
Chen a xquico', caj beta'b tu yochir xib. Quire' a xibo' mʌ' tarij ti' u winquirir xquic, chen a xquico' caj tar u winquirir ti' xib, a caj beta'b ten C'uj tu yʌnxchun tu cotor ba'.
Bayiri' xan, raji' yʌn bat'an beta'b a xibo', mʌ' pachir beta'b xib ten C'uj soc u nupintej xquic. Chen a xquico' pachir caj beta'b ten C'uj quir u nupintej xib.
Rajen, a xquico' ca' u pix u jo'r, aro' quir yesic cu surʌctic xib soc yʌjmasirob u t'ʌn C'uj c'ucha'an yor yiricob.
Mʌ' ja wirej, ich ʌcʌtan u wich C'uj, quet bayiri' a xibo', yejer a xquico'. A xibo' yʌn ba'wir ti' a xquico', bayiri' xan, a xquico', yʌn ba'wir ti' a xibo'. Yʌn pacran ba'wir ti'ob.
An ten bic a xquico' caj beta'b ten C'uj ti' u winquirir xib. Baxuc xan, a xibo', je' u rocha'r ten xquic, chen a C'ujo', raji' caj u betaj tu cotor ba'.
Tucrex ta junanex. Tsoy wa xquic cu t'ʌnic C'uj cax mʌ' pixa'an u jo'r?
Biquinin mʌ' ja werex bic tabar yʌn mac tera', wa xib cu cha'bʌr u sats'ʌr u jo'r, robob a'aric suracchʌjʌr wa cha'bʌr u sats'ʌr u jo'r.
Chen ti' a xquico', quij ya'araj ti', jach manan tsoy ca' sats'ʌc u jo'r soc jach c'ʌrʌb soc ir u p'oc u jo'r.

Wa ti' yʌn mac a ju c'at u ts'iquintic quire' aro', cha'j u p'ujur ti', quire' mʌ' nanij u t'ʌnic a xquico' wa mʌ' pixa'an u jo'r tu quin tsec'tic u t'ʌn C'uj. Mʌ' ju bin u yiricob ich u jer tu cu c'ujinticob C'uj, cu rʌc pixicob u jo'r.
Cu chich t'ʌnic ti'ob yoc'or u janʌnob tu cu janticob yo'och quir u c'ʌ'otej bic tabar quimij Jesús
A baje'rer xan, a ba' quin bin in wa'aric techex, yʌn ba' wa mʌ' jin c'at in wa'aric ca' a betex. Quire' wa ber ca much'quint a bʌjex soc tsoy ca betiquex chen soc a ba' mʌ' tsoy caj betex uch.

Rajen pʌyber, in c'at in wa'aric techex, wa ber ca much'quint a bʌjex yejer tu cotor a yacsmʌnob tu yorob, tu jumbintenob ti' yʌn mac pim tu yʌnechex a techexo', mʌ' quet yorob yejer junyar pim tu yʌnechex. Orac quin tucric taj a ba' caj u jumbinta tenob.
Quire' ra' cu yʌntar tu yʌnechex a mac a cu nunquicob u t'ʌn mac, soc chʌca'an ij quiriquex mac jach chich u yor ti' u t'ʌn C'uj.

Bayiri' xan, wa ber ca much'quint a bʌjex, soc quir a c'ʌ'otiquex a janʌnex a wo'ochex a caj u toc ar ic Jaj Ts'urirex soc rajra' ic janʌnex. A ba' ca betiquex tu yʌnechex ti taro', a teno', tin t'ʌn, mʌ' ja c'ʌ'otiquex a jantiquex yo'och a ic Jaj Ts'urirex a caj u toc araj soc rajra' ic janʌnex.
Quire' wa ber p'eri ca janʌnex, jujuntur a cuchmanex quir a janʌnex a ba' yʌn techex. Ti' yʌn u jer mac, a mʌna' ti', cu chen u'yic wi'ij. Ti' yʌn u jer cax cʌra'an.
Arex ten biquinin ca betiquex baxuco'? Biquinin ca pʌyiquex u su'tarob a mac a mʌna' ba' ti'? Ba' quin wa'aric techex quire' a ba' ca betiquex? A teno', mʌ' jach qui' in wor techex.
Bic tabar ca' ic jantex a yo'ocho', a oq'uino', a tu toc ara Jaj Ts'ur

Quire' a ba' ic Jaj Ts'urirex u yarmʌn ten uch, aro' ra'iri' caj in camsechex xan. A ic Jaj Ts'urirex Jesús, a ra' ac'biro' caj c'ubij ten Judas Jesús ti' u winiquirob judío, caj u chucaj a yo'och pano', quire' ra' u q'uinin cu janʌnob.

Barej caj ts'oc u ya'aric: “Bayo' C'uj”, quij, jeroj, caj u xat'aj, caj u ya'araj ti' u camsʌwinicob uch: “Ch'a'ex a je' pana' a cu c'asic techex in winquirir wa ber ca jantiquex. A teno', quin c'ubic in winquirir soc in quinsa' techex”, quij.

Bayiri' xan, caj ts'oc u janʌn Jesús, caj u ch'aj a ray chan rucho', caj ya'araj: “A je' chan rucha', quire' a ba' ti' yʌn ich chan ruch, cu tsicbar ti' a ric'ben a nupa'an t'ʌno', a C'uj toc nup t'ʌn techex, quire' je' in quimine' soc in joc'ar in q'uiq'uer. Aro' quir a c'ʌ'otiquenex wa ber ca much'quintic a bʌjex quir a wuq'uiquex. Uq'uexex aro', quir a cʌ'otiquenex a teno'”, quij Jesús.
Wa ber ca wuq'uiquex a ba' ti' yʌn ich a je' chan rucha', bayiri' xan wa ber caj jantiquex a je' pana', tan a ts'iquex ti' mac soc yerob biquinin ic Jaj Ts'urirex quimij.

Wa mac, ix ti', cu jantic a ray pano', bayiri' xan, wa mac cu yuq'uic a ba' ti' yʌn ich ray chan rucho', cu chen jantic, bayiri' yuq'uic xan, mʌ' tan u tucric ti' Cristo. A ray winico' je' u pʌyic ya'ab u si'pire', quire' a ray pano' yejer a ray uc'uro' cu tsicbar u winquirir yejer u q'uiq'uer Jesucristo.
Rajen jujunturo'onex ca' ij cʌxtiquex tij corex ij quirex wa tan ic tucriquex Cristo, soc c'ucha'an ij corex ic jantiquex a ray pano', bayiri' soc c'ucha'an ij corex ic uq'uex a ray uc'uro'.

Quire' a mac a cu jantic a ray pano', yejer a mac a cu yuq'uic a ray uc'uro', chen ix ti' mʌ' ju qui' cʌxtic tu yor wa cu tucric Cristo, je' u pʌyic ya'ab u si'pire' wa ber cu jantic a pano' yejer a uc'uro', quire' ra' u tsicbar u winquirir Jesús yejer u q'uiq'uer Jesús.
Rajen yʌn ya'ab mac tu' yʌnechex a tan u ts'abʌr u muc'yaj yejer u yajirir. Yʌn jun yarob quimij xan.
Rajen wa quij cʌxtiquex tij corex a ba' c'asir tic betex, jeroj tun, mʌ' ba'wir C'uj cu ts'ic to'onex ic muc'yajex.
Chen wa yʌn to'onex c'as tic betex, jeroj a C'ujo' bin u ca' u ts'ic muc'yajex baje'rer soc ca' bin c'uchuc tu q'uinin u xur t'ʌn, mʌ' ju ts'ic a muc'yajex yejer tu cotor a mac a mʌ' yerob C'uj.

Rajen in wet acsa'orirex wa ber ca' bin a much'quint a bʌjex quir a c'ʌ'otiquex a jantiquex yo'och ic Jaj Ts'urirex a caj u toc araj, soc rajra' ic jantex, ca' a pacran pajex a bʌjex soc p'eri' ca' janʌnex.

Wa ti' yʌn mac wi'ije', arej u janʌn ich u bʌjiri' yatoch soc mʌ' c'as cu betic, ca' bin a much'quintex a bʌjex quir a c'ʌ'otiquex a jantiquex yo'och, ic Jaj Ts'urirex a caj u toc araj soc rajra' ic jantiquex. Yʌn u jer ya'ab ba' in c'at in wa'arej techex chen ra' quin wa'aric techex ca' bin c'uchuquen ta wicnʌnex.
